Commentary.Commentary: For Ireland, Young was really good along with Adair at the start. The spinners too did a good job, especially Delany. Barry though did not have the best to nights as he was expensive. His spell could prove to be the difference. However, Ireland do have the batters to chase this down. The wicket seems a touch better than the last two games but they'll still have to bat well. Scotland will back themselves to defend this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

Scotland lost both their openers early but Jones and Richie counter-attacked and steadied the ship. However, the two fell in quick succession too but Cross and Leask yet again put up a good stand and when they were batting, 170 looked possible. Wickets through towards the end did not let Scotland get the finish they wanted but they still have a good score on the board.

Scotland have got to a total similar to what they got in their last game. It was enough then, will it be here in this one? We will have to wait for that. However, this innings was a total roller coaster ride.

TOSS - Scotland have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

It is time for game 5 of this Tri Series. The table is shaping up nicely. All the three teams have managed to win at least one game. Courtesy the washout a couple of days ago, Ireland and Scotland are a point ahead of the hosts. The Scottish bounced back strongly after being beaten in the first game of the tournament. They face a stiffer challenger here against Ireland who managed to beat the Dutch in their first game. Batting first has been the norm so far, will that continue? Also, the side winning this game will be placed at the top of the table. Let's hope for a good contest between bat and ball. Toss and teams in a bit.
... MATCH DAY ...

Things are heating up in this Tri-series as Ireland takes on Scotland in game No. 5. Both sides have had one victory in the tournament and have had one game washed out so far but Scotland have played one extra game. Ireland won their game in a thriller against the Netherlands and the reverse fixture was a washout. Scotland on the other hand started with a defeat against the Netherlands but they took their revenge and got one over the Dutch side and inflicted a heavy defeat on them in their last game. Both sides are coming into this game with some positive momentum and they would be eyeing a victory and getting one over their opponents in this fixture. Lorcan Tucker and Mark Adair looked solid with the bat for Ireland while Fionn Hand looks lethal with the ball as well. Ben White, George Dockrell and others will look to stamp their mark as well with some explosive bowling against Scotland. The side is well-balanced and is on the upward graph. Scotland on the other hand started poorly but convincingly won against the Netherlands in their previous game. The side batted well with George Munsey scoring heavily for them. The bowlers did tremendously to complement the batters and inflicted a heavy defeat on the Dutch helping their NRR as well. This game promises to be a thriller.
